$comment: Copy to bursar.config.json and edit. Amounts are ALWAYS base units as strings (wei for native ETH, 1e6 for USDC). Never floats.

treasury.$comment: 11155111 = Ethereum Sepolia. Chosen for development because it is one of only two chains with private mempool routing, so payout behaviour matches Ethereum mainnet exactly.

contributors.$comment: shareBps must sum to exactly 10000. Replace these with real addresses before running.
contributors.name: model-provider

float.$comment: Keep 0.01 ETH of gas on Sepolia; top back up to 0.05 when it dips. Below the floor the agent risks stalling mid-task.

yield.$comment: Disabled until the payout path is proven. Surplus is the last claim on the money, never the first. poolAddress is REQUIRED even while disabled — it is the Aave v3 Pool on this chain.
yield.$comment-minApyBps: Refuse to supply when Aave pays less than this. 0 (the default) means the rate gate can never refuse — set it deliberately. 50 = 0.50%.

sweep.$comment: Pull earnings in from the wallets that receive them. minAmount is a dust floor: below it, gas costs more than the sweep recovers.

policy.$comment: The security boundary, not a settings file. Deliberately tight for development: 0.02 ETH per transfer, 0.1 ETH per rolling 24h.
policy.$comment-assets: Per-token caps. A token with NO entry here cannot move at all — that is deliberate. decimals must match the token exactly; a mismatch is refused rather than rescaled.
policy.$comment-usd: The cross-asset ceiling. Six assets each generously capped add up to no ceiling at all, so value is priced and summed against one number. Every asset above needs a priceFeed, and so does native, or the config is rejected at load. maxPerDayUsd is in CENTS: 5000 = $50.00.
policy.$comment-staleness: Refuse to value against a price older than this. The read fails closed: not knowing what something is worth is not the same as it being worth nothing.
